build_multispan_qa_metric_reporter: build a MultiSpanQAMetricReporter instance with console and file channels for multi-span QA evaluation
create_multispan_qa_file_channel: create a MultiSpanQAFileChannel to generate evaluation output rows with predicted and true answer spans
test_normalize_answer: test the _normalize_answer method to lowercase, remove punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace from text
review_align_bags: review the _align_bags method that finds optimal 1-1 alignment between predicted and gold answer token sets
summarize_compute_f1: summarize the _compute_f1 method that calculates F1 score from predicted and gold token bag intersections
